<!-- pr-reviewer: 3c6192f1e09dae51356805dfee134cddb7e46250 -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The refusal condition (`!a.center_cutting`) is unchanged. No refused program is accepted and no accepted program is refused. The change is the hint text only, as issue #3247 asks.
- `graze_hint` splits the three cases by name (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_step.rs`): Arc entry with no lead-in, Arc entry that found no room, and the other entries. Each states what the user can change.
- The pinning test asserts the words, the refusal prefix constant `CENTER_CUT_REFUSAL`, and the absence of the old misleading phrase. It uses the real command history and the user's part, in the existing `contour_none_lead` binary.
- The commit is a conventional subject and its body ends `Fixes #3247`. The body has the `Changelog:` line and no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.

## Results

Built and tested on the self-hosted runner (`pr-test.yml` run 45029556551, https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45029556551), merged with main at `032b5dea7`. The head checked in the run matched the reviewed head. I also confirmed the trial merge locally with `git merge-tree`: clean, no conflicts.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate, merged tree | ok - 5 steps, 0 failed (motion build, motion lib, `level_links`, `one_descent`, app `contour_none_lead`) |
| Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The diff changes no `cfg(windows)` code and no per-OS value, so no Windows-only re-run was owed. No UI file is touched; the tests assert the refusal text, not pixels.

## Heavy lanes

The diff reaches the `motion heavy` and `app heavy` lanes. They ran by the author's gate-runner on this exact head (PR body section "Heavy lanes"): 242 steps in release, 0 failed; four known-fail tests (#1950 three times, #2849 once) failed as expected. The two light twins passed. This review relies on that run; the head matches. No golden file changed.

## Law check

- Prime Directive: no new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests; the only additions in `contour_step.rs` are a format argument and a match on `Entry3D`/`Lead`. `Lead` derives `PartialEq`, and `Step.arm`/`Params.lead` exist as used.
- Layering and placement: the new test lines sit in the existing app integration file; `camcraft-app` already depends on `camcraft-motion` (no new crate edge). No process file, no dependency, no project-format change.
- Files stay small: `contour_step.rs` is 167 lines; the test file is about 206.
- Issue #3247 is labelled `P3`, `bug`, `effort:low`, `in-review` - consistent with this fix.

## Requested before merge

Nothing.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The middle hint says "see the entry note". It points at the arc-entry note the generator writes when no arc fits. The wording is fine as is; a follow-up could name the note more directly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
